board.name: The Militarist

rules.name: Garrisons
rules.text: Income: +1 Agent a country a round.

rules.name: Troops where the Protector stands
rules.text: Each round: Muster 1 in each country where the Protector has a Node.

effects.note: 175: a Deploy like an event's: the lowest-numbered factory there (else city); on a hex Wall holds it stays in the supply; a Deploy prohibition and the level surcharge apply

rules.name: Warmongering
rules.text: Each round, a military base with an adversary Troop on or next to it makes 1 extra Drone, even past its cap; at most 1 extra a base in each production, whatever makes it.

difficulty.text: Militarist, harder: every Muster lands 1 more Troop a country, and the adversary gains 4 compute for each threat that executes uncountered.
flags: 151: unchanged but for the words (Deploy, board)

board.value: Garrisons: +1 agent a board a round, 2 at values.json (rally) a board a round, 4 a round at 2 boards, against one removal (5): 0.8x a round, but it lands every round of the game (about 40 over 10 rounds, the old board line's 2 on the corrupted city reworded as income). Wall troops: 1 troop (9) a round where the Protector stands, against one removal (5): 1.8x. Warmongering: 1 extra corp troop a qualifying base a production step (4), against removing the adversary troop (5).
